text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day during lunch break.
While looking through documents, I was having lunch in the trainer's office when...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Lunch with your paperwork again?
You two are so lovey-dovey it makes me jealous.
choice_data_list: Oh, what brings you here at this hour?
Oh, what brings you here at this hour?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to talk about our afternoon training session. Remember how
we talked about ramping up the intensity and extending the time for the upcoming race?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Well, my friends said they want to come cheer me on after finishing
their own workouts. It might get a little rowdy, is that okay?
choice_data_list: Not a problem at all, that's totally fine.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If anything, Daring Heart is the type who fires up when cheered on.
Recreating a race-like atmosphere is actually a big help for us.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Really? Thanks!
I'll let them know, then!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I'm all set!
Shall we get started?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text:
D-A-R-I-N-G! Heart!
D-A-R-I-N-G! Heart! Wooo!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Startled by the sudden chanting, I looked toward the stands
and saw a whole group holding up "Daring Heart" signs.
choice_data_list: H-Heart? By cheering, do you mean...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes.
Hehe, aren't they sweet?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
—Thank you for cheering for me!
I won't let your cheers go to waste♪

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friends
text_block_list.text: Wooo♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Afterward, we ended up having dinner together with Daring Heart
and everyone who had cheered for her—however...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hey, buddy!
We're not eating at the cafeteria today!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend C
text_block_list.text:
—All righty!
Let's get this Happy Dinner Time starteeed☆
choice_data_list: Um... is it someone's birthday or something?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
No way!
We'd put in way more effort if it were.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
We're not all in the same dorm, you know?
Think of this as our regular joint dinner party!

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend A
text_block_list.text:
Eating at the dorm and cafeteria every day gets boring!
...Though the staff still cooked the food!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Hehe!
Just changing the venue makes it pretty fun, doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend B
text_block_list.text:
—Well, we'll be heading out first!
Trainer, thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
...Phew~.
Just because tomorrow is a rest day, we totally overdid it on the routine.
choice_data_list: Yeah, make sure to take it easy.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Got it!
...By the way. What are your plans for tomorrow?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I tilt my head at her question. I don't really have any set plans,
as I was just going to review some training data at home, but...

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Actually, an acquaintance invited me to a garden party tomorrow.
...Would you like to come along?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It's a "theme party" this time.
We dress up and play games based on whatever theme the host chose.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
The theme this time is "Spies"...
So we act out roles as secret agents or bodyguards. What do you say?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I appreciate the invitation.
...But judging from how flashy and glamorous her circle is, I'd definitely feel out of place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She lives in a completely different world from my quiet everyday life.
...I don't want to show up unprepared and make things awkward for her.
choice_data_list: ...I'm not used to that kind of thing and might cause trouble, so this time—

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I see.
...In that case, your attendance is totally okay!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
After all, aren't we buddies who are going to
sprint through the Twinkle Series together?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
I need to get to know you better,
and you need to get to know me better too.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
To make that happen, I want to spend more time with you.
I want to share all kinds of experiences together.

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: Don't you think so?

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text: And with that said, may I have the pleasure of your escort!

text_block_list.name: Dearing Heart
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry, I'll be right by your side!
—Yes or Hell Yes?
